description: Portfolio defaults for pull request volume. A consumer overrides any of these by setting the same key in its own renovate.json.

prConcurrentLimit caps the open Renovate pull requests at 5. Where branch protection runs with strict: true, every merge re-queues the full workflow fan-out of every open branch -- fewer open branches is the lever (nolte/gh-plumbing#439, measurement in nolte/claude-shared#644).
Lowering prConcurrentLimit never closes an already-open pull request. The new cap takes effect as the open ones merge or close.
prHourlyLimit: 2 restates Renovate's own default and is set explicitly to document the intent.
Vulnerability alerts skip the line: their pull requests ignore these limits and are never grouped, so a security fix is never held back.

packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit digests. A tag is mutable even from a trusted publisher (CVE-2025-30066), so a digest is the only immutable action reference; pinDigests also makes each pin age as a reviewable pull request instead of silently.

Group every digest bump into one pull request. A digest bump carries no individual changelog, so a single grouped pull request loses no review signal and keeps the open pull request budget free for updates that do carry one. Portfolio default -- a consumer overrides it by setting groupName for the same matchUpdateTypes in its own renovate.json. Vulnerability alerts are exempt from grouping, so a security fix still arrives as its own pull request.

customManagers.description: Age the hacs/action digest. Its comment names a branch rather than a version, because hacs/action's newest tag dates from 2022, and the github-actions manager resolves a comment through the github-tags datasource where a branch name finds nothing. This manager resolves the same line through git-refs instead.

Age the hassfest digest. Its comment names a branch rather than a version, because home-assistant/actions has no usable release tag, and the github-actions manager resolves a comment through the github-tags datasource -- where a branch name finds nothing and no bump is ever proposed. This manager resolves the same line through git-refs instead, so the pin ages like every other one.
